286.literal: When it's this cold, my tongue won't work.
286.official: It's too cold. My tongue's frozen stiff.

287.literal: Well, after you've just finished a job,
287.official: There's just no beating a beer at the end of a job!

288.literal: Have I made myself understood, Kiryu-san?
288.official: Have I earned your understanding, Kiryu-san?

289.literal: It's the least I can do to take responsibility, Nishiki. I'll handle this properly.
289.official: This is about me taking accountability, Nishiki. Let me do this right.
